svg.text: Look-alike places can score high too.
The belief lives on a metric grid that
covers mapped cells, unmapped cells and
a far state Ω. Odometry shifts it into and
out of holes; it is never forced back onto
the map. A filter bank self-calibrates
f_on: best match when on the map.
f_off: best look-alike when the true place
is absent. Both are learned without labels
from the filter's own confident fixes.
